scope: Focused primary-source web inspection, not exhaustive literature review, not data admission or reproduced likelihood. Remote source bytes not custodied here.

papers.title: A precise extragalactic test of General Relativity
papers.finding: Joint imaging and spatially resolved kinematics; gamma=0.97 +/-0.09. A potential-ratio test, not independent total-mass calibration at0.239%.
papers.inference: A constant-gamma posterior is not automatically a likelihood for the radially varying scalar candidate.

papers.title: Extragalactic test of general relativity with time-delay gravitational lenses
papers.finding: Four H0LiCOW lenses plus BAO reconstruction; gamma=0.93 +0.16/-0.17, ratio route0.89 +0.19/-0.15. Paper identifies published distance PDFs/chains and preserved correlations.
papers.inference: Public data exist; a mapping from the complete TGL to this observable is still required. These gamma errors are not mass errors or sigma_beta; no significance conversion performed.

papers.title: Strong Gravitational Lensing and the Stellar IMF of Early-type Galaxies
papers.finding: Population synthesis and spectroscopy combined with lens masses for18galaxies; allowed IMF and dark-matter fractions discussed.
papers.inference: This joint procedure is not evidence of a total-mass anchor independent of lens gravity at the required precision.

not_claimed: A gamma discrepancy is a beta measurement.
